newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Ibex hits high at close amid few sellers.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Ibex hits high at close amid few sellers.

text.p: Spain's Ibex-35 blue chip share index rose 1.79 percent to a fresh record close at 7,094.95 on Wednesday, pushed up primarily because of a lack of sellers rather than any fresh factors, dealers said.
Much of the session's volume was accounted by put-throughs, dealers added.
Strong rises in key shares Repsol and Telefonica, recovering from a less brilliant recent performance, had supported the rise.
Dealers pegged initial resistance at 7,100 or 7,200, but underlined the market's need to correct.
